query:
SELECT 
  p.id, 
  p.name, 
  p.latin_name, 
  p.conservation_status,
  COUNT(pgz.zone_id) as zone_count
FROM plants p
LEFT JOIN plant_geographic_zones pgz ON p.id = pgz.plant_id
WHERE p.id IN (240001, 240002, 240003, 240004, 240005, 240006)
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.latin_name, p.conservation_status
ORDER BY p.id;
